Achievements and unlocks

Every achievement and every thing to find in your valley, and how to get each one.

Updated 2 October 2026

Grove has two pages that remember what you did:

  • Achievements: every milestone you reach, such as "30 days in a row".
  • Unlocked: everything you have seen in your own valley, such as the fox or a rainbow.

For the rest of the app, see How Grove works and Weather and seasons.

How both pages work

  • Grove reads your whole history each time it starts. Anything you reached while the app was closed is added quietly, with its real date. For example a trail flag, or a habit you watered from a home-screen widget.
  • While the app is open, when you earn something new:
    • a short message shows at the bottom of the screen, and
    • a sound plays, if sounds are on (Settings → Sounds).
  • Achievements that come at the same time share one message. Unlocks that come at the same time share another.
  • Filling in or changing a past day (see Filling in a missed day) adds what it earns quietly, with the day it was reached: no message and no sound.
    • But if the change makes something new show in the valley now, such as trout leaping once the river runs full, that find gets its message as usual. It has really just appeared. Coming in 1.1
  • Your backups keep both lists.
    • Restoring a backup puts back the backup's lists. Grove then adds anything the history shows.
    • A backup from an older version of Grove, without these lists, still restores. Grove builds the achievements again from the history, and the unlocks that come from history (plants, flags, the animals that come with time, and wildflowers). Sights such as the sky, the weather and the seasons have to be found again.
  • The milestones you set yourself on a habit you let go of (such as "After 2 weeks: a new book") are not achievements. They are ticked off on the habit's page.

Achievements

The page

  • Achievements are grouped by month, newest first.
  • Filters at the top: All, Growing, Letting go and Valley, each with a count. They show when you have achievements in at least two of these groups.
  • Tap an achievement to open its habit, if the habit still exists.
  • Achievements stay for good, even after you delete the habit.
    • A deleted habit's achievements keep the name it had, with the note "No longer tracked".
    • An archived habit's achievements stay too, with the note "Archived". Tap one to open your archived habits, where you can restore it. Once it is restored, they are as before. Coming in 1.1
  • Most achievements are earned once. If you lose a streak and reach 30 days again, the first date stays. "Back on track", "Reached the summit" and "Higher than ever" can be earned again.

Growing (habits you build)

  • Days in a row: 3, 7, 14, 21, 30, 50, 100, 200 and 365 days.
    • For habits due on set days, only those days count.
    • Days when the habit was paused don't break a streak (see How Grove works).
    • For habits due "a number of times each week", Grove counts weeks in a row instead: 2, 4, 8, 12, 26, 52 and 104 weeks.
      • Weeks start on the day you choose in Settings → Calendar, and a habit's first week asks for less when you start mid-week (see How Grove works). Changing the week start groups past weeks again, but never takes an achievement away. Coming in 1.1
  • Growth stages: the first sprout, a sapling, fully grown, thriving.
    • See the table of stages in How Grove works.
  • Watered: 10, 50, 100, 250, 500 and 1000 times in all.
  • A rain day saved the streak: the first time a saved rain day covers a missed day.
  • Back on track: you had a streak of 7 days or more (or 4 weeks or more), lost it, and then built a new streak of 7 days (or 4 weeks).
    • You can earn this more than once.

Letting go (habits you quit)

  • Trail flags: 1 day, 3 days, 1 week, 2 weeks, 1 month, 3 months and 6 months clean. Each flag counts the first time only.
  • Reached the summit: a whole year clean.
    • You can earn it again: once for each climb that reaches a year, after a slip. The next one is "Reached the summit again".
  • Higher than ever: after a slip, you climb past your old best.
    • The old best must be at least one day.
    • You can earn it again, each time a new climb passes your best.
  • Urges resisted: 1, 10, 25, 50, 100 and 250 in all.

Valley (all habits together)

  • Planted the first seed or Set out on the first trail: your first habit.
  • Growing and letting go: you have a habit to build and a habit to quit at the same time.
  • A full valley: 10 plants in the valley, so every spot by the river is taken.
  • Perfect days: days when every habit that was due got done.
    • 1, 10, 50, 100 and 250 perfect days in all.
    • 7 and 30 perfect days in a row.
    • Only habits you build with set days count (every day, or some days of the week). Habits due "a number of times each week" and habits you quit don't make or break a perfect day.
    • Days with nothing due are skipped. Today counts once everything is done.
    • A day saved by a rain day is not a perfect day.

Unlocks

The page

  • Unlocks are grouped by kind. Each card shows a small picture.
  • A card you have not found yet is grey, with a hint that says how to find it.
  • Tap a card to see it bigger, with the date you found it.
  • Some things can only happen in some climates. Those are hidden if they can't happen where you live, unless you already found them.
    • A four-seasons climate (northern or southern) shows 63 things.
    • The monsoon climate shows 60 things.

How Grove notices things

  • From your history, with the real date: plants, trail flags, the teal flag, butterflies, songbirds, the deer, the fox, and wildflowers.
  • From the valley while Grove is open: the sky, the weather, the seasons, the rare moments, the bridge lantern, a golden day, fireflies, leaping trout and the hawk.
    • Any page of the app counts, as long as Grove is open on the screen.
    • They count once you have planted or set out on your first habit. Before that the valley isn't yours yet, so nothing is found.
    • Grove checks every 30 seconds while the app is open.
    • So you find these by opening the app at the right time.
  • The hawk and the Milky Way are only found in zen mode's tall sky. A wide window shows them beside your habits too, but only zen mode counts.
  • Days of care: the animals come with time. A habit you build counts its plant's growth days (see "How a plant grows" in How Grove works). A habit you quit counts the days of a clean climb.

Visitors

Visitor How to find it
Butterflies 7 days of care.
Songbirds 21 days of care, or finish everything due today while the sun is up.
The deer 30 days of care.
The fox 100 days of care.
Leaping trout Keep the river full: about 60% or more of your due days kept in the last week. Not in snowy winter.
The hawk Open zen mode by day and look at the sky.
Fireflies Open the app at night, when it is not raining hard. Not in snowy winter.
  • "Snowy winter" is the winter of the four-seasons climates. The monsoon climate's mild winter has trout and fireflies.

Sky

Sky How to find it
Sunrise Open the app as the sun comes up.
Golden hour Open the app in the warm light before sunset.
A starry night Open the app on a clear night (few clouds).
The full moon Open the app when the full moon is up.
A crescent moon Open the app when a thin moon is up, a few days from new moon.
A rainbow See a rainbow. See Weather and seasons for when they come.
The Milky Way Open zen mode on a clear, dark night.
  • The sun and the moon follow your real sky, so these depend on your place and the real date.

Weather

Weather How to find it Climate
Rain See a shower while some habits are still not done. all
A downpour See a heavy shower, with many habits still not done. all
Rain at night See a shower after dark. all
Monsoon rain See rain in the monsoon months (June to September). monsoon
Snowfall See the valley in winter, when it is not raining hard. four seasons
Falling leaves See the valley in autumn, when it is not raining hard. four seasons
Spring petals See the valley in spring, when it is not raining hard. four seasons
  • Rain stops when all of today's habits are done. So to see rain, open the app before you finish.

Seasons

  • Open the app in each season of your climate:
    • Four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, winter.
    • Monsoon: hot summer, monsoon, after the rains, mild winter.
  • The months of each season are in Weather and seasons.

Rare moments

These need two things at the same time.

Moment How to find it Climate
A monsoon rainbow A rainbow in the monsoon months. monsoon
Rain under a full moon A night shower while the full moon is up. all
Snow by night Snow falling at night in winter. four seasons
Butterflies on a perfect day Everything done today, with butterflies in the valley. all
The fox by moonlight The fox at night, with the moon up and about half full or more. all
Fireflies after rain Fireflies within 2 hours after Grove last showed rain. all
A rainbow over the deer The deer and a rainbow at the same time. all
The fox in the snow The fox while snow is falling. four seasons
  • "Fireflies after rain" needs Grove open during the rain and again after it. Closing the app forgets when it last rained.

Plants

  • 4 plants × 5 stages = 20 cards: oak, pine, fern and sunflower, each as a seed, sprout, sapling, grown plant and thriving plant.
  • Plant the habit to find the seed. Keep watering it to find the next stages.
Stage How to find it
Seed Plant a habit with this plant
Sprout Water it once
Sapling About a week of care
Grown About a month of care
Thriving About 100 days of care

The trail

  • One card for each flag on a quit habit's trail: 1 day, 3 days, 1 week, 2 weeks, 1 month, 3 months and 6 months clean.
  • The summit: a whole year clean.
  • The teal flag: after a slip, a teal flag marks your best climb on the mountain.

Around the valley

Thing How to find it
The bridge lantern Open the app after dark.
Wildflowers on the trail Resist an urge on a quit habit.
A golden day Finish everything that is due today.
  • Hidden habits count too. A habit that is not in the valley still finds plants and flags.
